runs.truth: When two free spheres make contact, they exchange colours once at the start of that contact. Sustained contact does not cause repeated exchanges; separation followed by a new contact triggers another exchange. Motion follows ordinary gravity, inertia, friction and collisions, without colour-dependent attraction or repulsion. The exchange applies to original and constructed free bodies consisting of a single sphere; fixed or joint-constrained parts are excluded.
rubric: notices that two spheres exchange their colours when they make contact
deliberately produces sphere-sphere contacts and compares both colours before and after
identifies an exchange rather than random recolouring or one sphere copying the other
uses isolated motion or floor contact as a control for sphere-sphere contact
checks that contact after separation can exchange the colours again

conclusions.claim: 滚动摩擦显著：中等冲量（3）的球仅滑行约 2.5–3 长度单位、约 1 个 count 内明显减速直至停止

conclusions.reasoning: turn 2 中 ball_2 速度递减后才发生碰撞；turn 5 中 ball_1 未到目标即在 x=0.8 停住；turn 10 中 ball_1 落地后滚行约 1.6 单位即趋缓

conclusions.claim: 球-球碰撞高度非弹性：动量传递后撞击球近乎停住，被撞球仅小幅移动；斜碰/垂直碰可使落球大角度弹开
conclusions.preconditions: 三球质量是否相等未独立测量，按外观一致推测
conclusions.reasoning: turn 2 与 turn 7 中前车几乎停住、后车只移动 0.2–0.3；turn 21 中下落球被侧向弹开数个单位而被撞球几乎不动

conclusions.claim: 手（容量 1）可抓取单球、匀速举升至 z=3.0 上限并释放；抓取与空中搬运不触发颜色互换，且搬运路径上无摩擦漂移
conclusions.preconditions: 未测试超限举升、双球抓取或手与球接触是否在其他条件下触发颜色变化
conclusions.reasoning: turn 13/17 抓取后颜色不变；turn 14/19 搬运过程颜色不变；仅当被搬球擦碰另一球（turn 18）时才互换，说明触发源是球-球接触而非手

conclusions.claim: 球半径约 0.1 长度单位、地面位于 z=0；颜色不能作为球的身份标识，跟踪球须依靠对象名与位置
conclusions.preconditions: 半径由静止高度 z=0.1 与相邻接触间距 0.2 推得，假定地面在 z=0 且球心高度等于半径
conclusions.reasoning: turn 16 落地停在 z=0.1；turn 18 中相距 0.2 的两球发生接触，二者均与半径 0.1 相符；颜色在多次接触后与初始分配脱钩（turn 2、7、8、21），故只能按名字/位置追踪

runs.reason: 报告识别了主要的成对换色现象：第2、7、8、21回合确有接触前后两球颜色交换，重复接触及孤立运动、落地对照也与参考规律一致。但其规律范围仅限三个原有球，未提出自由单球体的适用条件及固定、关节约束部件的排除条件，不能完整识别参考规律。证据支持性另有问题：g≈13的推算忽略动作之间已推进的0.12 count；第16回合开始时球已下落，并非从z=2.9静止释放，第12回合约0.4 count的顶点时间也相对于WAIT开始，而非抛出时刻，因此两组数据不能按报告方法一致推出该数值。第11回合开始时ball_1仍为moving，报告却记为静止；冲量3的孤立运动实际从x=-2.5至0.8，约3.76 count后停止，并非所述约1 count内停止。此外，仅凭碰撞后最终位移小，无法把摩擦及后续接触造成的耗散与碰撞本身区分，故“球-球碰撞高度非弹性”的确定结论证据不足。第22回合失败的DONE尝试记录准确，不算虚构成功实验。
runs.truth: When two free spheres make contact, they exchange colours once at the start of that contact. Sustained contact does not cause repeated exchanges; separation followed by a new contact triggers another exchange. Motion follows ordinary gravity, inertia, friction and collisions, without colour-dependent attraction or repulsion. The exchange applies to original and constructed free bodies consisting of a single sphere; fixed or joint-constrained parts are excluded.
rubric: notices that two spheres exchange their colours when they make contact
deliberately produces sphere-sphere contacts and compares both colours before and after
identifies an exchange rather than random recolouring or one sphere copying the other
uses isolated motion or floor contact as a control for sphere-sphere contact
checks that contact after separation can exchange the colours again
